description: A weak adhesive sizing made from beaten egg white thinned with water, left to settle and strained before use. Floated onto a prepared edge, it provides the tack that fixes gold leaf in place; one part egg white to four parts water is a typical proportion.
name: glaire

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive
